[SWS_CM_00129] Ensuring the existence of SetHandler
⌈
Upon a call to
OfferService() in a skeleton implementation for a given service, error handling
according to [SWS_CORE_00001] shall be performed, if for at least one contained
Field having hasSetter = true no SetHandler (see [SWS_CM_00116]) has been
registered yet.
⌋

[SWS_CM_00129] Ensuring the existence of SetHandler
⌈
Upon a call to
OfferService() in a skeleton implementation for a given service, the following error
check shall be made: if for at least one contained Field having hasSetter = true no
SetHandler (see [SWS_CM_00116]) has been registered yet, the error code Com-
Errc::kSetHandlerNotSet shall be returned in the result type of OfferService().
The error shall be logged.
⌋

The error shall be logged.
